chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Husayn narrated from Safwan from Ishaq ibn 'Ammar who said:

I said to Abu Ibrahim (peace be upon him): A man who performed the Umrah (Ziyarah) and completed all the Tawaf of his Hajj, which do you prefer: that he performs Tawaf with the House (Kaaba) again, or that he proceeds on his way to Mina? He said: 'Whatever he wishes, he may do, provided he does not spend the night (in Mina before the 13th of Dhu al-Hijjah).'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for a pilgrim who has completed Umrah and wants to know if they should perform extra Tawaf or go to Mina?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights the flexibility (rukhas) granted to pilgrims in the rites of Hajj, specifically regarding the timing of departure from Mecca to Mina. Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies that the pilgrim is not bound to perform an extra Tawaf if they choose to proceed directly, provided they adhere to the temporal constraint of not spending the night in Mina before the prescribed time for those who hasten (Qad). This ruling underscores the Shia jurisprudential principle of ease in worship, allowing pilgrims to prioritize their spiritual state or logistical needs without invalidating their Hajj.
